system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: The account support_tmp was created by kim.ortega, then added to the group recorded as Administrators; its name and privileged-group membership conflict with the stated temporary-account process.

A successful Remote Interactive logon for kim.ortega to WS-RIYER-01 came from 198.51.100.77. The domain controller also recorded a service ticket for kim.ortega to that workstation from the same address.

The organization states remote administration is only performed from WS-KORTEGA-01 inside the office and there is no VPN. The observed remote logon to WS-RIYER-01 from 198.51.100.77 is inconsistent with that practice.

On WS-RIYER-01, kim.ortega created a scheduled task whose PowerShell command uses a hidden window and an encoded command. The encoded command decodes to a web request for, and execution of, a script at http://198.51.100.77/s.ps1.
The unusual account creation and privileged membership, unauthorized remote access pattern, and task configured to retrieve and execute a script together strongly support malicious activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show the task registration and its command, but do not show the task starting, the script being retrieved, or the script executing (S06-00123).
The supplied records do not establish whether support_tmp was subsequently used or what actions it performed (S06-00121, S06-00122).

The records identify 198.51.100.77 as the source address and script URL, but do not establish who controlled that address or whether any request to the URL succeeded (S06-00092, S06-00095, S06-00097, S06-00123).
claims_not_established: Whether the scheduled task ran or successfully downloaded and executed the remote script.
Whether support_tmp was used to authenticate or perform activity after creation.
Whether kim.ortega personally performed these actions or the account/session was compromised.
Whether there was an approved exception or change authorizing the account, group membership, remote logon, or task.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect task scheduler operational and execution history for SyncCheck, plus process-creation telemetry around and after 13:42 UTC on WS-RIYER-01.
Collect proxy, firewall, and endpoint network telemetry for any request to 198.51.100.77, including whether s.ps1 was retrieved.
Review domain-controller account and group-change audit details, including any subsequent logons, password changes, or activity by support_tmp.
Validate the kim.ortega logon and source address with the administrator, and review authentication and endpoint evidence for compromise.
Check the change-management system and help-desk records for authorization of support_tmp, its group membership, and the scheduled task.
